description: Apple's own search popularity, from the Apple Ads account connected to this workspace: the most searched terms in the country for the app's category (weekly, Apple's order), each with rank in the category and popularity 1-100 (in category and country-wide) and 1-5 (the Apple Ads scale), plus every tracked keyword marked inTopTerms true or false. Pass terms to check more words. connected=false means Apple Ads is not connected.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

limit.description: top terms to return, up to 200 (default 50)

terms.description: extra terms to look up, comma-separated, up to 50

name: get_search_popularity
